// Format critical items for email const data = $input.first().json; const critical = data.categorized.critical; const sheetsUrl = `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${$env.GOOGLE_SHEETS_FINANCE_ID}`; let itemsList = ''; critical.forEach(exp => { itemsList += ` ${exp.merchant} $${exp.amount.toFixed(2)} ${exp.daysOverdue} days Row ${exp.rowNumber} `; }); const emailHtml = `

URGENT: High-Value Receipts Overdue

The following high-value expenses are missing receipts and are significantly overdue:

${itemsList}
Merchant Amount Days Overdue Location

Total at risk: $${data.totals.critical.toFixed(2)}

These items must be addressed immediately for tax compliance. Expenses without receipts may not be deductible.

View and Add Receipts

`; return [{ json: { ...data, emailHtml, emailSubject: `URGENT: ${data.counts.critical} High-Value Receipts Overdue ($${data.totals.critical.toFixed(2)})` } }];
